app-url.label: resolved app URL
app-url.install: Pass an explicit URL argument, or ensure commands.run resolves and can be started in the foreground; otherwise this skill asks where the app is running

claude-plan-executor.label: claude-plan-executor (Codex skill)
claude-plan-executor.install: Vendored by this plugin; run `node scripts/link-agent-skills.mjs`

clean-tree.label: clean working tree
clean-tree.install: Commit or stash outstanding changes first

gh.label: GitHub CLI
gh.install: brew install gh && gh auth login

git-repo.label: git repository
git-repo.install: Run from inside a git repository

github-remote.label: GitHub-hosted remote
github-remote.install: The repo remote must resolve to github.com — a GitLab or Bitbucket remote does not satisfy this

interactive-user.label: interactive user
interactive-user.install: Requires an interactive session (AskUserQuestion); unavailable headless

linear.label: Linear MCP
linear.install: Ships as a plugin dependency; authorize the connector, then restart the session

open-pr.label: open PR
open-pr.install: The current branch needs an open pull request (`gh pr view`)

orca.label: Orca CLI
orca.install: Ships with the Orca desktop app; register it in Settings → General → Orca CLI

orca-repo-registered.label: repo registered with Orca
orca-repo-registered.install: Run `orca repo add` for this repo, or add it from the Orca app

orca-runtime.label: reachable Orca runtime
orca-runtime.install: Launch Orca, or run `orca open`, then re-run — `orca status` must report runtimeReachable: true

orca-terminal.label: running inside an Orca terminal
orca-terminal.install: Start Claude Code from an Orca terminal so the orchestration run can bind to it (`orca orchestration run-current` works there)

orchestration.label: Orca orchestration skill
orchestration.install: Ships with the Orca app; `orca skills get orchestration` must print the guide

permission-mode-auto.label: --permission-mode auto
permission-mode-auto.install: Relaunch with --permission-mode acceptEdits if auto is rejected (never bypassPermissions)

plan-file.label: plan file
plan-file.install: An implementation plan must exist under docs/.superpowers/plans/

playwright-video.label: Playwright video tools
playwright-video.install: Set PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CAPS=devtools in the settings.json env block, then restart

python3.label: Python 3
python3.install: brew install python, or the python3 from Xcode Command Line Tools

resolved-install-command.label: project install command
resolved-install-command.install: Resolved at runtime from the repo's own install/resolution layer (e.g. `make install`); there is no fixed install step — install project dependencies yourself if none resolves

star-home.label: running in STAR's docs repo
star-home.install: Open an Orca terminal in ~/juel-star (or $JUEL_STAR_HOME) and run /juel:star there; the first run creates the files

superpowers:brainstorming.label: superpowers:brainstorming
superpowers:brainstorming.install: Ships as part of the superpowers plugin dependency

verification-criteria.label: acceptance criteria to verify
verification-criteria.install: Provide acceptance criteria via the work item or the spec file, or answer when this skill asks for concrete verification steps

work-source-create-capable.label: work-source provider with create capability
work-source-create-capable.install: Configure a tracker that can create items (Linear, Jira, GitHub, or a spec directory) as `tracker` in .claude/workflow.json or a `## Work Source` block in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md

work-source-list-capable.label: work-source provider with list capability
work-source-list-capable.install: Configure a work-item provider that supports listing (e.g. Linear MCP), or paste refs / point at a spec directory

worktree-root-cwd.label: cwd at worktree root
worktree-root-cwd.install: Run with the working directory set to the worktree root

writable-cwd.label: writable cwd
writable-cwd.install: Run somewhere the current directory is writable (`test -w .`) — a permission claim, not a location claim
